label: D2 after choosing a2, strongest when a2 rare-transitions to S1
explanation: Fires only at D2 (zero on D1 and GO), and almost only when this trial chose a2 (98% of mass; (D2 & action==2) has recall 0.99 but precision 0.28). Magnitude is set by the reached state: a2 followed by a rare transition to S1 gives ~0.3-0.5 of max, a2 to S2 (common) gives only ~0.0-0.15. The recorded predicate (D2, a2, reached S1) captures ~80% of activation mass with precision ~0.58. Rate also rises when the agent is strongly committed to a2 (policy logit choice < -4.44 at D2: F1 0.57, mass recall 0.95), after rewarded trials, and late in the episode (trials 50-89). The very largest activations (max) are rare cases where a1 led to S1 (common) after a run of a2 choices, i.e. reaching S1 against a strong a2 preference. Does not fire after a1 normally, nor on D1/GO. All variables used are observed at D2.
